name: 知识库检索
description: 让 Agent 检索你自建的 LightRAG 知识库；文档解析可交给 mineru.net，长文告别「AI 不知道这是什么概念」。
author: arsonist-g

agentTools.name: kb_search
agentTools.description: Search the user's personal knowledge base (a self-hosted LightRAG server) for a term, concept or internal note. Call this before answering when the user uses a name, abbreviation or piece of jargon that may only be defined in their own documents.

query.description: What to look up. A term or a short question; the same language the user wrote in works best.

mode.description: Retrieval mode. mix (default) combines the knowledge graph with vector search; naive is vector search only and is the fastest.

topK.description: How many candidate items to retrieve (1-100). Defaults to the plugin setting.

settings.title: LightRAG 服务地址
settings.description: 例如 https://kb.example.com ，不要带结尾斜杠。留空则 kb_search 会提示未配置。

settings.title: LightRAG API Key
settings.description: 服务端 .env 里的 LIGHTRAG_API_KEY。存在插件的私有设置文件里，不要提交到版本库。

settings.title: 默认检索模式
settings.description: mix 质量最好；naive 只走向量检索，最快。

settings.title: 默认召回条数
settings.description: 每次检索返回的候选数量，1-100。

settings.title: 单条片段字符上限
settings.description: 每条命中内容截断到这个长度，避免一次塞满上下文。0 表示不截断。
